claims.verbatim:
Steamship America (Brem), Meyer, Bremen May 13 via
Southampton 16th, with mdse and 702 passengers, to Oelrichs
& Co. Experienced during the greater part of the voyage
light variable winds and fine weather. The steamship Alle-
mania (Hamb), and steamship Herman (Brem), arrived at
Cowes on the 15th inst, the former at 1 PM and the latter at
10 PM; 24th, lat 41 37, lon 63 30, passed a Brem bark steering
westward; 25th, lat 40 58, lon 69 10, steamer Brazillian (Br),
from Liverpool for New Orleans.

Steamship America (Brem.), Meyer, Bremen 13th inst. and South-
ampton 16th inst., with mdse. and 702 pass. to Oelrichs & Co. Expe-
rienced during the greater part of the passage light variable winds and
fine weather. The Hamburg steamship Allemania and the Bremen
steamship Herman arrived at Cowes on the 15th inst., the former at 1
p. m. and the latter at 10 p. m. 24th, lat. 41 37, long. 63 30, passed a
Bremen bark, steering W; 25th, lat. 40 58[?], long. 69 10, W. L. British
steamship Brazilian, steering W.
